decisions.reason: Although this plugin is close to the core offer and benefited from prior investment, its disappearance from website observation after 2019 suggests reduced public commitment and makes a formal withdrawal more likely than continued standalone support.

This ERP interface plugin still fits the firm's stated direction toward broader multichannel and tailored commerce support, so management would be inclined to justify past investment and retain it despite weaker visibility.

Given that two comparable price-comparison tracking plugins were already removed in 2019 and this one also ceased to be observed later, the remaining commitment is weak and management would likely redeploy resources elsewhere.

As a small adjacent plugin with no later observed market presence, it no longer carries enough visible strategic or public commitment to outweigh the pull to concentrate resources on the established business and newer development.
